title: ILEARN International Limited to be wound up following resolutions
excerpt: ILEARN International Limited, based in Rochdale, has passed resolutions for voluntary winding-up, appointing a liquidator to oversee the process.
body:
ILEARN International Limited, located at Globe House, Globe Park, Moss Bridge Road, Rochdale, has passed resolutions for voluntary winding-up as of 4 November 2026.

The company, which also operated from the Chadderton & Learning Development Centre, Middleton Road, Oldham, appointed Peter John Harold of Bespoke Insolvency Solutions as liquidator for the process.

Peter Harold can be contacted for further details via email at info@bespokeinsolvency.co.uk. Mark Gandy is listed as an alternative contact.

This development follows a formal notice published in The Gazette on 12 November 2026, indicating the company's decision to cease operations.

corrections.note: Corrected on 12 November 2026: an earlier version stated a fact that the source reports differently. The article now reflects what The Gazette reports.
